[[File:Corrupted scarab icon.png]] The '''corrupted scarab''' is a monster that requires level 91 [[Slayer]] to damage and a [[feather of Ma'at]] to complete each kill (the [[legendary pet]] ability 'Slayer Finisher' does not work). They can be found in the [[Sophanem Slayer Dungeon]].

A safe spot can be found at the east side of the northern building, behind the flat stones at its south-east corner.

A cat named [[Katarina]] has a chance to spawn upon each successful kill.
